title: JournalEvent
description: One line of a run journal's events.jsonl — the append-only provenance record (ARCHITECTURE.md §4). Each property carries an x-conformance marker: 'normative' fields form the cross-runner conformance set (§3.3), 'excluded' fields (timestamps, durations, the runner.* namespace) are never compared. This classification drives #29's determinism assertion and the V2 conformance harness (#40).

type.description: Selects the map visit start record.

terminalCause.description: Versioned diagnostic explanation committed atomically with run.finished; absent in legacy journals.

schema.description: Versioned envelope id. A reader branches on this; a newer version is read leniently (unknown fields/types tolerated).

seq.description: Monotonic per-run sequence number from 1. The primary ordering key; at tier 3 events order by (branch, seq).

type.description: Event kind. init.completed, trigger.fired, tick.skipped, workflow.starved, workflow.refused, workflow.readmitted, provider.quota.reset, poll.shed, claim lifecycle/lock, config.*, daemon.*, and telemetry.retention.pass (a bounded automatic-retention pass summary) are instance-journal-only (scheduler/events.jsonl, ARCHITECTURE.md §4/§6); the rest appear in a run's own events.jsonl (run.started/run.finished are reused in both streams).
type.x-conformance: conditional: stage.heartbeat, gate.started, gate.paused, init.completed, daemon.*, telemetry.retention.pass, runner-scoped bookkeeping, and notification output events are excluded; all other event types are normative unless separately excluded

branch.description: Parallel-branch id. 0 at tiers 1-2; reserved for tier-3 parallel branches. Secondary ordering key.

time.description: When the event was recorded. Excluded from conformance.

stage.description: Stage name for stage.* events and stage-scoped artifacts.
stage.x-conformance: conditional: excluded for stage.heartbeat; otherwise normative

attempt.description: 1-based attempt number for stage.* events and stage-scoped artifacts.
attempt.x-conformance: conditional: excluded for stage.heartbeat; otherwise normative

attemptClass.description: Why a non-initial attempt exists. 'policy' and operator-requested 'human' attempts are normative; 'infra' attempts are excluded from the conformance set. The initial attempt carries no class and is always included.
attemptClass.x-conformance: conditional: excluded for stage.heartbeat and when 'infra'

actor.description: Human/operator identity for an auditable intervention.

decision.description: Configured gate branch selected by a run.resumed intervention.

instructionAddendum.description: One-off instruction text supplied for stage.rerun.requested.

rationale.description: Required operator explanation for a gate override intervention.

gate.description: Gate name for gate.* events. gate.started and gate.paused are operational bookkeeping excluded from conformance; gate.evaluated and gate.overridden are normative.

verdict.description: Gate decision for gate.evaluated or gate.overridden.

target.description: Branch/state selected by a gate or chosen by run.resumed.

complete.description: Whether a run.resumed intervention selected the workflow's terminal completion branch.

escalated.description: Whether the gate evaluation selected its escalation control branch.

status.description: Terminal status for run.finished / stage.finished, or the prior terminal phase for run.resumed.

disposition.description: Whether a terminal run performed work. New run.finished events carry produced or no-work; absence is accepted for journals written before disposition was introduced.

workflowVersion.description: Immutable workflow version re-asserted by run.resumed.

workflowDigest.description: Immutable workflow digest re-asserted by run.resumed.

sourceRunId.description: Source run for a continuation provenance record.

sourceTerminalSeq.description: Selected terminal source sequence for a continuation.

outputs.description: Small, named scalar values a stage.finished's ResultEnvelope.Outputs carried (docs/stage-contract.md) — journaled so a resumed run can reconstruct a finished stage's result (its lastStage/lastResult, or a resumed gate's subject) without it having lived only in the runner's process memory.

artifacts.description: A stage.finished's ResultEnvelope.Artifacts — the pointers this attempt produced — for the same reconstruction reason as outputs.
artifacts.x-conformance: conditional: each entry's digest and integrity are normative, path/size/mediaType are not

workspaceRevision.description: Verified immutable authority promoted from a successful deterministic stage result.

integrity.description: Provenance grade on an input snapshot, artifact, or integrity-admission refusal.

minimumIntegrity.description: Declared stage threshold on an integrity-admission refusal.

name.description: Label for a Ref (artifact/input name) or the redaction target.

dataSchema.description: Record shape identifier for schema-aware span content (span.recorded), e.g. a GenAI transcript schema URI. Excluded from conformance: harness/LLM transcript shape is not compared across runners (ARCHITECTURE.md §3.3), the same basis as the runner.* namespace.

redaction.description: Old->new digest remediation for redaction events.

parallel.description: Name of the fan-out state the event concerns: the parallel on parallel.*, the map on map.*, and the owning parallel or map on branch.*. Normative.

branchName.description: Declared name of the branch this event concerns, or a map item's roster identity; the numeric id is in `branch`. Normative.

mapItemIdentity.description: Roster identity of the map item a branch.started or branch.finished concerns. Absent for a static branch. Normative.

mapItemDigest.description: Canonical digest of the map item a branch.started or branch.finished concerns: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 form of {identity, item}. Absent for a static branch. Normative.

mapRoster.description: Frozen, normalized roster on map.started: the durable source of truth for the map visit. Resume rebuilds item branches from it and never rereads the producer.

branchStatus.description: Terminal status of a branch on branch.finished. Normative. A skipped branch never starts, so it appears only in the completeness record, never on branch.finished.

completeness.description: Branch completeness record on parallel.finished: one entry per DECLARED branch, in declaration order (which is what assigns branch ids). Normative — it, not the interleaving, is what a parallel means.

branch.description: Numeric branch id assigned from declaration order.

name.description: Declared branch name from the workflow's parallel block.

status.description: Terminal outcome recorded for the branch. 'skipped' means a selective parallel's frozen selection did not choose this optional branch.

artifacts.description: Count of artifacts recorded by the branch before it finished.

reason.description: Optional human-facing reason a selective parallel records: the selection's reason for a selected branch, or why a skipped branch did not run. Excluded from conformance.

mapItemIdentity.description: Roster identity of a map completeness entry on map.finished. Absent for a static branch.

mapItemDigest.description: Canonical item digest of a map completeness entry on map.finished. Absent for a static branch.

selection.description: Frozen selection of a DSL 3.1 selective parallel, present only on that parallel's parallel.started. Resume rebuilds the skip set from it alone. Normative except reasons and source.visit.

runner.description: Runner-specific annotations. The ONLY sanctioned runner-specific divergence and ALWAYS excluded from conformance.

notificationRequest.description: Exact provider-neutral request recorded before dispatch. The event is operational output and excluded from workflow conformance.

notificationReceipt.description: Durable delivery or suppression result. The event is operational output and excluded from workflow conformance.

operatorMessageRequest.description: Accepted provider-neutral operator message. The event is operational output and excluded from workflow conformance.

operatorMessageAcknowledgement.description: Durable operator acknowledgement. The event is operational output and excluded from workflow conformance.

operatorMessageOutcome.description: Terminal delivery or rejection result. The event is operational output and excluded from workflow conformance.

agent.description: Versioned nested-agent provenance projected by a structured adapter.

progress.description: Operator-readable progress update emitted intentionally by a nested agent or adapter without retaining hidden chain-of-thought.

peerMessage.description: Orchestration-relevant peer metadata; raw message content is never retained.

workflow.description: Instance-journal only: workflow name for a scheduler decision (trigger.fired, tick.skipped, poll.shed, or an instance-level run.started/run.finished echo). Not present in a run's own events.jsonl.
workflow.x-conformance: not applicable (instance journal, not a run's conformance set)

gaggle.description: Instance-journal only: gaggle that scopes the workflow name.
gaggle.x-conformance: not applicable (instance journal, not a run's conformance set)

runId.description: Instance-journal only: the run a scheduler decision or claim transition pertains to.
runId.x-conformance: not applicable (instance journal, not a run's conformance set)

reason.description: Instance-journal only: short, stable explanation for a scheduler decision or daemon lifecycle event. On claim.released and claim.force_released it is the release disposition code (claimRelease.disposition).
reason.x-conformance: not applicable (instance journal, not a run's conformance set)

skipCount.description: Instance-journal only: consecutive shared-pool refusal count at a workflow.starved threshold crossing.
skipCount.x-conformance: not applicable (instance journal, not a run's conformance set)

claimRelease.description: Instance-journal only: why a claim ended, on claim.released and claim.force_released (#4421). Absent on events written before the field existed, which readers treat as an unknown release.
claimRelease.x-conformance: not applicable (instance journal, not a run's conformance set)

disposition.x-conformance: not applicable (instance journal, not a run's conformance set)

stage.description: Workflow stage or gate the holding run ended at, when known.
stage.x-conformance: not applicable (instance journal, not a run's conformance set)

code.description: Stable error or disposition code, when known.
code.x-conformance: not applicable (instance journal, not a run's conformance set)

summary.x-conformance: not applicable (instance journal, not a run's conformance set)

actor.description: Operator identity behind a force-release, when known.
actor.x-conformance: not applicable (instance journal, not a run's conformance set)

mapRoster.description: Frozen roster of one map visit (plan-driven-dynamic-fan-out.md §6.2).

source.description: Immutable reference to the frozen source document and the producer attempt the journal bound it to.

visit.description: Producer stage.started sequence the artifact publication was bound to; a runner-local journal sequence.

attempt.description: Producer attempt number that published the source.

digest.description: Content digest of the source artifact.

integrity.description: Provenance grade of the source artifact, inherited by every mapped binding.

path.description: Source blob location relative to the run directory. Not normative.

size.description: Source blob length in bytes. Not normative.

mediaType.description: Source blob media type. Not normative.

failurePolicy.description: Map failure policy at freeze time.

itemTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-item budget in seconds at freeze time; absent when unbounded.

maxConcurrent.description: Effective concurrency bound at freeze time.

items.description: Normalized roster: unique identities sorted by bytewise UTF-8 order; item i runs as branch i+1.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 serialization of {identity, item}.

item.description: Canonical item object bound into the mapped task.

consumed.description: Additional executions actually consumed; excludes the initial execution.

allowed.description: Additional executions allowed by the pinned policy.

selector.description: Name of the causal gate, stage or condition.

message.description: Human explanation scrubbed through journal policy.

poll.description: Consumed and allowed timeout polls, separate from policy repasses.

causalEventSeq.description: Sequence of the decisive event in this journal.

causalEmitKey.description: Deterministic engine op key resolved to the actual sequence by a live writer.

path.description: Blob location relative to the run directory. Runner-arranged; not normative.

digest.description: Content address. Normative except for runner-assembled context-manifest artifacts, whose bytes include non-normative pointer metadata.
digest.x-conformance: conditional: excluded for runner-assembled context-manifest artifacts

size.description: Blob length in bytes. Derived; not normative.

mediaType.description: Optional media type (parity with the wire ArtifactPointer). Not normative.

provider.description: External system that owns the referenced object.

kind.description: Provider-specific object kind, such as issue or pull_request.

id.description: Stable identifier of the external object within the provider.

url.description: Convenience link. Not normative — identity is (provider, kind, id).

commitSha.description: Commit observed for a branch reference.

schema.description: Versioned schema identifier for the agent provenance record.

id.description: Stable identifier for this agent invocation.

parentId.description: Identifier of the parent agent invocation, when nested.

runId.description: Run that owns this agent invocation.

stage.description: Workflow stage that launched the agent.

attempt.description: One-based stage attempt containing the invocation.

plugin.description: Adapter or plugin that executed the agent.

objective.description: Bounded objective assigned to the agent.

coordinator.description: Whether the invocation coordinates child agents.

worker.description: Whether the invocation performs delegated worker tasks.

leaf.description: Whether the invocation has no child agents.

resolvedModel.description: Model selected by the executing adapter.

requestedReasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort requested before adapter resolution.

resolvedReasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort selected by the executing adapter.

lifecycle.description: Current lifecycle state of the agent invocation.

updatedAt.description: Time the lifecycle record was last updated.

budget.description: Usage budget assigned to the invocation.

usage.description: Observed usage attributed to the invocation.

usageAggregated.description: Whether usage already includes descendant invocations.

results.description: Artifacts or external references produced by the invocation.

dependsOn.description: Agent invocation identifiers that must complete first.

fidelity.description: Completeness of lifecycle telemetry emitted by the adapter.

model.description: Model attributed to the invocation usage.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens attributed to the invocation.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens attributed to the invocation.

cacheReadTokens.description: Cache-read tokens attributed to the invocation.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Cache-write tokens attributed to the invocation.

reasoningTokens.description: Reasoning tokens attributed to the invocation.

nanoAiu.description: Exact nano-AIU attributed to the invocation.

costUsd.description: Estimated invocation cost in US dollars.

id.description: Stable identifier for the peer message.

senderId.description: Agent invocation that sent the message.

recipientId.description: Agent invocation intended to receive the message.

occurredAt.description: Time the peer message was emitted.

purpose.description: Orchestration purpose without retaining raw message content.

artifact.description: Artifact reference carrying message content, when persisted separately.

contentHash.description: Digest of the omitted raw message content.

schema.description: Versioned schema identifier for the agent progress record.

agentId.description: Stable identifier for the agent invocation whose progress is reported.

runId.description: Run that owns the progress update.

stage.description: Workflow stage that launched the agent.

attempt.description: One-based stage attempt containing the invocation.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence index within the agent invocation attempt for stable resumable ordering.

source.description: The origin of the status payload.

occurredAt.description: Time the agent status update was emitted.

updatedAt.description: Time the status entry was last updated.

fidelity.description: Completeness of progress telemetry emitted by the adapter.

summary.description: Bounded checkpoint summary suitable for reconnect or resume.

plan.description: Ordered milestone list for a plan update.

progress.description: Completed milestone or current activity for a progress update.

decision.description: Conclusion or decision selected by the agent.

blocker.description: Dependency, missing input, or policy/resource constraint.

question.description: Input requested from a human or another agent.

nextAction.description: Immediate intended action for the next step.

evidence.description: Observable fact or artifact references cited by the update.

type.description: Kind of evidence cited by the agent.

id.description: Stable pointer or event identifier for the evidence.

ref.description: Artifact or input reference that grounds the cited evidence.

message.description: Human-facing detail. Excluded (varies run to run).

causes.description: Ordered wrapped-error cause chain derived from structured error wrapping, absent when unavailable for legacy events.

code.description: Stable machine-readable cause code when the cause exposes one.

class.description: Stable cause class when the cause exposes one.

target.description: Named artifact or transcript target that was redacted.

oldDigest.description: Digest of the original content before redaction.

newDigest.description: Digest of the scrubbed content after redaction.

reason.description: Human-facing explanation of why the content was redacted.

parallelSelection.description: Normalized selection a selective parallel froze from its source slot before any branch started.

source.description: Journal-bound producer attempt the selection document came from.

visit.description: Producer's artifact publication visit, a runner-local journal sequence.

attempt.description: Producer attempt that published the document.

sourceDigest.description: Digest of the frozen source document.

integrity.description: Integrity of the source artifact, recorded for audit; the selection is never branch input.

selected.description: Selected optional branch names in branch-id order. Non-optional branches always run and are never listed.

reasons.description: Optional human-facing reason per selected branch, at most 512 bytes each.

additionalProperties.description: Reason recorded for one selected branch.
